# FauxPas

Cultural risk intelligence for market entry. An agentic due-diligence desk:
enter a brand and a target market, receive an explainable risk dossier.

- Dossiers: composite risk score (0-100, banded LOW/GUARDED/ELEVATED/SEVERE),
  embrace/reject segment map, red flags with evidence, concrete mitigations.
- Method: per-dimension affinity deltas (market affinity minus brand affinity)
  from taste-graph data; deterministic flag rules; no black-box scores.
- Stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind v4. Prototype JSON store.
- Status: prototype running on mock taste data; production wiring documented
  in lib/qloo/qloo-client.ts.
